name: schema-copy-resync
title: Refresh stale .hexscope/schemas copies
description: Re-seed the generated .hexscope/schemas/*.schema.json copies when the bundled schema differs (content-diff) on registry/pool writes, so existing workspaces pick up schema changes; never touch the data files (structs.json/profiles.json/bindings.json) and keep the no-write-on-open contract.
creator: deviousprophet
